prd_summary: Driver onboarding flow with personal details, vehicle details, document upload placeholder, and application status screens.
features: Collect personal details in a dedicated onboarding screen
Collect vehicle details and submit supported fields to backend
Show document upload UI placeholders until upload API exists
Display application review status with refresh support
user_flows: Login -> OTP -> Personal Details -> Vehicle Details -> Upload Documents
Login -> OTP -> Application Status when onboarding status is documents_uploaded
Login -> OTP -> Home when onboarding status is approved
relationships: Vehicle Details -> Upload Documents (profile create success)
decisions: DOB and referral code stay UI-only until backend supports them
Document upload remains placeholder-only until upload API exists
Personal and vehicle details share a single onboarding bloc across the first two screens
assumptions: GET /v1/profile may return additional driver fields for prefill, but onboarding must still work if it does not
Only documented driver onboarding statuses are available from backend
